sources.title: GitHub - Helsinki-NLP/Opus-MT: Open neural machine translation models ...
sources.snippet: Train MT models There is a Makefile for training new models from OPUS data in the Opus-MT-train repository, but this is heavily customized for the work environment at CSC and the University of Helsinki projects. This will (hopefully) be more generic in the future to be able to run in different environments and setups as well.

sources.title: opus-mt-tc-big-he-en huggingface.co api & Helsinki-NLP opus-mt-tc-big ...
sources.snippet: opus-mt-tc-big-he-en is an open source model from GitHub that offers a free installation service, and any user can find opus-mt-tc-big-he-en on GitHub to install. At the same time, huggingface.co provides the effect of opus-mt-tc-big-he-en install, users can directly use opus-mt-tc-big-he-en installed effect in huggingface.co for debugging and trial. It also supports api for free installation.
